title: 'Not another list of measures, but a stopwatch'
text: India's clean air suffers from 'seasonal amnesia'; rankings reward swept roads while the air stays toxic, 'missing the wood for the trees'. A filter installed in 2034 cannot clean the air a child breathed in 2026.
use: For essays on action and delay: 'The cost of being wrong is less than the cost of doing nothing', 'Shelving hard decisions is the least ethical course'.

title: Seven years of arguing over theatre commands
text: India's services have debated theatre commands for seven years; the US took four decades and several disasters to reach true jointness. 'The next security crisis will not wait for the services to finish arguing.'
use: For 'Shelving hard decisions is the least ethical course' and 'A ship in harbour is safe, but that is not what ship is for'.

title: The farmer who copied a friend's strawberries
text: In Manauli, Sonipat, Arun Chauhan switched from paddy to sweet corn after visiting a friend's strawberry farm. His village moved 70% of its land to sweet corn and vegetables, formed an FPO and now sells directly to e-commerce firms.
use: For 'The cost of being wrong is less than the cost of doing nothing', 'Ideas with large consequences are simple' and 'A ship in harbour is safe'.

title: Two fathers behind two India cricketers
text: Behind Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy, who won a T20I for India in New Zealand, stand two fathers who had hard years. Nitish's father, Mutyala Reddy, left a stable job at Hindustan Zinc Limited to support his son's practice in Visakhapatnam. Tilak's father, Nagaraju, an electrician, spent sleepless nights making ends meet so that his son could concentrate on cricket.
use: For the role of parents and family in shaping a child's future: sacrifice made quietly, years before any success is visible. Fits 'Hand that rocks the cradle rules the world' (the family as the first institution).

title: From 'use and throw' to 'use, return and recover'
text: Delhi's planned bottle-deposit scheme. Uttarakhand's version raised bottle return rates from about 20% to nearly 90% with a refundable Rs 10 deposit.
use: For nature and ethics essays: small nudges, big behaviour change ('Ideas with large consequences are simple').
